answer: An oasis sells leases on a ridge; each lease decays every epoch and must be re-bought. To add an identity, a wander must walk the account's ridge from its last host to a new host and sign the extension; the oasis then charges one oasis per host already on the ridge, so the kth identity costs k and a fresh host is appended, not reset. A tenth identity costs ten oasis per epoch and a tenth live host; ten cost 55, one costs one. No wander can fork a ridge, so clones cannot be opened in parallel from one account.
